result.markdown: --- title: "[Graph.adamic_adar_index()]{.doc-object-name .doc-function .doc-label .doc-label-method}" body-classes: doc-api-page page-navigation: false html-table-processing: none --- ::: {.doc-subject} Compute Adamic-Adar index for node pairs. ::: ::: {.doc-usage-source} Usage [Source](https://github.com/rich-iannone/edgecase/blob/main/python/edgecase/graph.py#L8869-L8944){target="_blank" rel="noopener"} ::: ::: {.doc-signature .doc-Kind.FUNCTION} ```python Graph.adamic_adar_index(ebunch=None) ``` ::: ::: {.doc-text} For each pair of nodes `(u, v)`, computes `Σ(1 / log(|N(w)|))` for all common neighbors `w`. This gives more weight to common neighbors that themselves have fewer connections (rarer connections are more significant). ::: ## Parameters {.doc-parameters} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [ebunch]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [list[tuple[Union[int, str], Union[int, str]]]]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [None]{.doc-parameter-default} : List of node pairs to compute predictions for. Each pair can use node IDs (integers) or labels (strings). If `None`, computes for all pairs of nodes that are not already connected. ::: ## Returns {.doc-returns} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [list[tuple[int, int, float]]]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : List of `(u, v, index)` tuples where index is the Adamic-Adar score. Results are returned with node IDs. ::: ## Technical Notes {.doc-technical-notes} - time complexity: `O(k)` per pair where `k` is the average degree - more accurate than common neighbors for many real networks - handles hub nodes better by downweighting their contribution - score is unbounded (higher is better) ## Examples {.doc-examples} Predict links giving more weight to rare common neighbors: ::: {#00aa2306 .cell execution_count=1} ``` {.python .cell-code} import edgecase as ec graph = ec.Graph(directed=False) # Create a network with a hub (node 1) and peripheral nodes graph.add_node() # Hub node 1 for i in range(2, 10): graph.add_node() graph.add_edge(1, i) # Hub connected to all # Nodes 2 and 3 share hub as common neighbor # But hub has high degree, so contributes less predictions = graph.adamic_adar_index([(2, 3)]) # Returns e.g., "Adamic-Adar: 0.455" f"Adamic-Adar: {predictions[0][2]:.3f}" ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=1} ``` 'Adamic-Adar: 0.481' ``` ::: ::: Compare with common neighbors: ::: {#c1ad2ce8 .cell execution_count=2} ``` {.python .cell-code} graph = ec.Graph(directed=False) graph.add_cycle_graph(6) pairs = [(1, 3), (1, 4)] cn = graph.common_neighbors(pairs) aa = graph.adamic_adar_index(pairs) for (_, _, count), (u, v, score) in zip(cn, aa): # Prints e.g., "1-3: CN=0, AA=0.000" f"{u}-{v}: CN={count}, AA={score:.3f}" ``` :::
